title: Heap Fragmentation Explorer
description: The learner will explain why a memory request can fail when enough total memory is free, by predicting the outcome of 6 allocation requests on a fragmented 16-cell heap and choosing the reason.
creator: Open Study Buddy
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Study Buddy
Computer Science
heap
garbage collection
heap fragmentation
MemoryError

educational.learningObjective: The learner will explain why a memory request can fail when enough total memory is free, by predicting the outcome of 6 allocation requests on a fragmented 16-cell heap and choosing the reason.

controls: Succeeds and MemoryError buttons: predict the outcome of each request
Reason buttons: pick why a request fails
Collect garbage button: frees B, D, F and H without moving other objects
Allocation-order buttons: buffer first, or objects spaced first
pedagogical.model: Rule-based heap model: first-fit allocation of runs of consecutive free cells on an illustrative 16-cell heap; a non-moving garbage collector.
